block.create_tem_quarry.quarry.tooltip.s: Builds a _gantry frame_ over an area and digs it out layer by layer. Runs on _rotational force_.
block.create_tem_quarry.quarry.tooltip.b: Opens the _settings_: area size, offset, frame height, dig depth, _style_ and fluid handling.
Columns and beams take _metal girders_, the fence takes _andesite bars_. Feed them into their two slots by hand or with funnels; the quarry stocks what the frame needs.
Pull items out with _funnels_ or chutes, and fluids with _pipes_. Fortune or Silk Touch _books_ go in the enchantment slot.
create_tem_quarry.gui.width.hint: Size of the dug area, left to right
create_tem_quarry.gui.length.hint: Size of the dug area, away from the quarry
create_tem_quarry.gui.offset.hint: Shifts the area left (-) or right (+) of the quarry
create_tem_quarry.gui.frame_height.hint: Height of the shortest column; the others grow to keep the top level
create_tem_quarry.gui.min_y.hint: Lowest Y level the quarry digs
create_tem_quarry.gui.pending_rebuild: Applies on close: rebuilds the frame
create_tem_quarry.gui.slot.enchantment.h: Fortune or Silk Touch book or tool
create_tem_quarry.gui.slot.void_filter.h: Drops matching this item or filter are destroyed
create_tem_quarry.gui.slot.output.hint: Extract with funnels, chutes or hoppers
create_tem_quarry.command.configured: Quarry set to %sx%s, offset %s, frame height %s, %s
create_tem_quarry.command.supplied: Stocked the quarry's frame and filled its material slots
create_tem_quarry.command.restarted: The quarry will dig again from the top
create_tem_quarry.command.too_far: Too far away from that quarry
create_tem_quarry.gui.number_hint: Click to type, drag or scroll to change. Shift: bigger steps
create_tem_quarry.gui.style.hint: Only changes how the machinery looks

create_tem_quarry.fluid_mode.collect_pau: Pump fluids into the tank; wait while it's full

create_tem_quarry.gui.remove_frame.off_h: Off: the frame stays standing. A quarry placed facing it takes it over.
